_doc: Hybrid hexploration spatial state for the Kingmaker campaign (read/written by the Hexploration world-tick subsystem; see .claude/skills/pathfinder2e/bridge/reference/hexploration.md). Geography is authoritative inside a hex; the usage_ledger leans cluster/seed draws toward un-surfaced content.
notes: Campaign not yet begun. Default staging point: Oleg's Trading Post (RL1, Zone 1 Rostland Hinterlands). At Session Zero the PC may instead open in Restov (Ch 1). As hexes are reconnoitered, add them to 'explored', record any keyed site in 'revealed_sites' (format 'HEXCODE:Site Name'), and increment 'usage_ledger' when a hex's content surfaces. Authored hex sites are in adventures/ch02-into-the-wild-hexcrawl-*.md (tagged location:<hexcode>).
